AL.name: Geological Survey of Alabama, Well Records (Groundwater Water Well Finder)
AL.note: links to the Water Well Finder map (groundwater.gsa.state.al.us); click a well for construction and water level; about half of 100,000 paper records are online

AK.name: Alaska DNR Well Log Tracking System (WELTS)
AK.note: search by owner, driller, subdivision, MTRS, borough, city, or map; driller's logs since 1987

AZ.name: ADWR Registry of Wells in Arizona (Wells 55) map
AZ.note: map of registered wells with report and imaged record per well; search by parcel or location; azwater.gov pages blocked the fetch, map title confirmed

AR.name: Arkansas Water Well 2.0 (water well construction reports, USGS-hosted)
AR.note: well construction reports database linked from the Water Well Construction Committee page; fetch returned 403 so not verified

CA.name: DWR Well Completion Report Map Application
CA.note: map of well completion reports (OSWCR); click a section to open redacted report PDFs; most pins placed at section center

CO.name: Colorado DWR Well Permit Search
CO.note: search by permit number, address, subdivision, county, or map; links to scanned permit and construction documents

CT.name: Connecticut DCP Well Drilling Completion Reporting
CT.note: reports from 1970 on are held by DCP, not DPH; reports filed since 2021 are under Public Reports on eLicense; older ones requested by year drilled

DE.name: DNREC Well Viewer
DE.note: map of existing wells; search by permit number, address, or parcel number; opens permit and completion documents

DC.name: DC Well Permits open dataset
DC.note: DC has no well-log system; nearly all of DC is on public water; DOEE publishes a well permit dataset only

FL.name: Florida Dept. of Health, Well Construction in Florida (lists the five water management districts)
FL.note: Florida has no single statewide well database; well permits and completion reports are searched at the district for the county: NWFWMD, SRWMD, SJRWMD, SWFWMD (www18.swfwmd.state.fl.us/search/search/wcpsimple.aspx), SFWMD ePermitting; some counties are delegated to the health department

GA.name: Georgia EPD Water Well Standards Act contractors page
GA.note: Georgia has no public well-log database; well construction reports are filed with EPD and the driller; ask the driller for the owner copy or file an Open Records request with EPD

HI.name: CWRM Well Information Request
HI.note: the online Well Index Database was taken down for security; submit the Well Information Release Request form to get well records

ID.name: IDWR Find a Well Map
ID.note: map of well locations; click a well then More info for the driller's report; also links the Well Construction Search; most reports since 1987

IL.name: ISGS ILWATER interactive map (water and related wells)
IL.note: page links the ILWATER map (go.illinois.edu/ilwater) with scanned well records; the ISWS domestic well database requires a free login; ISWS will run a search by email

IN.name: Indiana DNR Water Well Record Database
IN.note: over 400,000 records; Water Well Records Viewer searches by street address and ZIP; no owner-name search

IA.name: Iowa Geological Survey GeoSam
IA.note: geologic site and well database with map and table search; well logs and strata for located wells

KS.name: Kansas Geological Survey Water Well Completion Records (WWC5)
KS.note: search by county or section-township-range, or by map; scanned completion forms and lithologic logs

KY.name: Kentucky Groundwater Data Repository, Water Well and Spring Records Search
KY.note: search by county, quadrangle, radius around a point, or AKGWA number; construction, lithology, and scanned drillers' logs

LA.name: SONRIS data index, Groundwater Well Information (Water Wells by Parish)
LA.note: index page pointing into SONRIS (sonris.com) for water well registrations by parish, driller, owner, and water level; SONRIS interface changed Oct 2025

ME.name: Maine Geological Survey Water Well Database
ME.note: map and table well search with depth, yield, overburden; records since 1987; maine.gov returned 403 to the fetch so not verified

MD.name: Maryland Geological Survey, Obtaining Your Well Records
MD.note: no statewide online database; well completion reports come from the county health department environmental health office; page lists each county contact

MA.name: MassDEP Well Database (SearchWell)
MA.note: search well completion reports by town, well ID, type, or date; page is a JavaScript app and mass.gov returned 403, so not verified

MI.name: EGLE Well Record Retrieval System (scanned pre-2000 records) and Wellogic
MI.note: pick county, township, town/range, section for scanned records 1999 and older; records 2000 on are in Wellogic (egle.state.mi.us/wellogic), which returned 503 during this check

MN.name: Minnesota Well Index (MWI)
MN.note: map; search by unique well ID, township-range-section, address, or owner; well logs with depth and static water level

MS.name: MDEQ Water Well Drillers and State Well Reports
MS.agency: MDEQ Office of Land and Water Resources
MS.note: no public search tool; OLWR keeps State Well Reports (driller's logs) for all drilled wells; contact the office for a record

MO.name: Missouri DNR water data page: Well Drilling Logs Viewer and WIMS 2.0
MO.note: links the Well Drilling Logs Viewer map (location, construction, water level, geology) and WIMS well search; few records before July 1987

MT.name: Montana Ground Water Information Center (GWIC)
MT.note: Search Our Data by township-range-section, subdivision, site name, GWIC ID, or county; driller's logs, water levels, quality

NE.name: Nebraska DWEE Registered Wells search
NE.note: filter by well ID, registration number, county, NRD, township-range, owner, or date; detail pages with scans

NV.name: Nevada Division of Water Resources Well Log Search
NV.note: search by log number, basin, township-range-section, county, parcel number, owner, driller, or dates; well driller's reports

NH.name: NHDES Water Well Inventory
NH.note: over 135,000 well completion reports since 1984 searched through NHDES OneStop (click Water Well, enter address); des.nh.gov returned 403 so not verified

NJ.name: NJDEP Well Permitting and Program Information (Online Reports)
NJ.note: Online Reports / DataMiner well search for permits, well records, and decommissioning reports since 1946; page is a JavaScript app that returned no text, so not verified

NM.name: NM Office of the State Engineer Water Rights and POD lookup
NM.note: links the Water Rights Reporting System for well reports and point-of-diversion (POD) records and a POD location finder

NY.name: NYS DEC Water Well Contractor Program (Water Well Information Search)
NY.note: links the Water Well Information Search (upstate, since 2000) and DECinfo Locator with completion report PDFs including Long Island

NC.name: NC DEQ Groundwater Data (Hydrogeological Database Search and map)
NC.note: links the Hydrogeological Database Search (ncwater.org) by lat/long or map; private well construction records are held by county health departments

ND.name: ND Department of Water Resources map services: Well Drillers Logs
ND.note: links the Well Drillers Logs map (mapservice.dwr.nd.gov, Drillers layer) with scanned drillers' reports

OH.name: ODNR Water Wells interactive search
OH.note: search by county/township/street, record number, address, or radius; well logs since 1946, 900,000+ records; app page title confirmed

OK.name: OWRB Wells and Licensing (Water Well Records search)
OK.note: links the Water Well Search map (experience.arcgis.com) for well logs by location; not all pre-2000 logs are entered

OR.name: Oregon WRD Well Report Query
OR.note: search by township-range-section, county, tax lot, owner, well log ID, or map; water well reports with depth and yield

PA.name: Pennsylvania Groundwater Information System (PaGWIS)
PA.note: records search runs in PaGEODE (gis.dcnr.pa.gov/pageode); search by county, municipality, driller, date, owner, or map; drillers' completion reports

RI.name: RIDOH Private Well Care, Repairs and Construction
RI.agency: RIDOH Center for Drinking Water Quality
RI.note: no online database; RIDOH holds well completion reports since 1972, contact 401-222-6867; health.ri.gov returned 403 so not verified

SC.name: SCDES Coastal Plain Water Well Inventory
SC.note: map of Coastal Plain wells with drill logs, geophysical logs, and tests; not a complete inventory; Piedmont wells not covered

SD.name: South Dakota DANR Well Completion Reports search
SD.note: search by township-range-section, county, city, owner, depth, date, driller, or map buffer; download PDFs

TN.name: TDEC Water Resources Well Data Viewer
TN.note: well log tracking system viewer with well locations and driller's logs; tn.gov and dataviewers.tdec.tn.gov returned 403 so not verified

TX.name: Texas Water Development Board Groundwater Data and Well Reports
TX.note: links the Groundwater Data Viewer map for submitted driller's reports (2001 on) and the TCEQ Water Well Report Viewer for scanned reports before 2003

UT.name: Utah Division of Water Rights Well Log Search
UT.note: search by section-township-range or radius around a point; filter by date, depth, diameter, well type

VT.name: Vermont ANR Well Completion Report database
VT.note: search by well tag, report number, E911 address, owner, driller, town, or date; reports since 1966

VA.name: VDH Real Estate Transfer FAQ (private well records)
VA.note: no statewide online well database; local health department holds records, in VENIS since 2003, paper 1990-2003, often none before 1990

WA.name: Washington Ecology Well Report Viewer
WA.note: map or text search of well reports with construction and lithology

WV.name: WV DHHR Individual Water Supplies
WV.note: no online well database; well permits and SW-258 completion reports are held by the local health department

WI.name: Wisconsin DNR Well Construction Information System public search
WI.note: search by Wisconsin Unique Well Number, county and address, or township-range-section; well construction reports with depth, water depth, yield

WY.name: Wyoming State Engineer's Office Ground Water FAQ (e-Permit search)
WY.note: well permits are looked up in e-Permit (seoweb.wyo.gov/e-Permit) by township-range-section; public search works without an account, direct search page was a login screen
